name.value: The Cold Bodies Under the Cap

description.value: Perhaps eighty separate persons beneath the night-side ice cap, each made of between nine hundred and four thousand replaceable bodies, none of which is anybody. A colony that loses a third of its bodies in a bad season treats this as an illness and not as a bereavement, which is the clearest statement anybody has of why individuals do not apply here. Each draws organic fall from the ice around it on a standing claim and administers nothing and nobody, which is why the entry sits in the social register at all.

role.value: silent trade counterparty at the ice line
